# Memory

Memory lets CUGA **learn from past runs**. Before a similar task, it injects guidelines into the prompt. After the run, it saves the trajectory so the next time is faster and less error-prone.

The engine behind it is [altk-evolve](https://pypi.org/project/altk-evolve/). You enable **Memory** in settings; you do not wire Evolve as a separate product.

<Callout type="info">
**Architecture:** Memory is a **Capability layer** feature. Trajectories persist in Postgres/pgvector (Persistence). See [How CUGA works](/docs/start/how-it-works#3-capability-layer).
</Callout>

---

## What happens during a run

<MemoryFlow />

If Memory is unavailable, times out, or returns nothing, CUGA continues — it never blocks the task.

---

## Enable

Memory is used in **CugaLite**. Turn it on in `settings.toml`:

```toml
[evolve]
enabled = true
mode = "auto"
app_name = "evolve"
lite_mode_only = true
save_on_success = true
save_on_failure = true
async_save = true
timeout = 30.0
```

The `[evolve]` keys are the Memory backend. Full list: [Settings reference](/docs/configure/settings-reference#memory).

---

## How the Memory service runs

<Tabs items={['Registry-managed (recommended)', 'Standalone SSE server']}>
<Tab value="Registry-managed (recommended)">
Let the CUGA MCP registry launch it. In the Manage UI, add an MCP tool with:

- **Name**: `evolve`
- **Connection type**: `Command (stdio)`
- **Command**: `uvx`
- **Args**: `--from altk-evolve --with setuptools<70 evolve-mcp`

Add these env values on the same tool:

```bash
EVOLVE_BACKEND=postgres
EVOLVE_PG_HOST=localhost
EVOLVE_PG_PORT=5432
EVOLVE_PG_USER=postgres
EVOLVE_PG_PASSWORD=postgres
EVOLVE_PG_DBNAME=evolve
EVOLVE_MODEL_NAME=Azure/gpt-4o
OPENAI_API_KEY=env://OPENAI_API_KEY
OPENAI_BASE_URL=env://OPENAI_BASE_URL
```

`env://VAR` reads from CUGA's own environment at runtime. Leave `mode = "auto"` (or `"registry"`) and `app_name = "evolve"`.
</Tab>
<Tab value="Standalone SSE server">
Run the service yourself (useful for debugging):

```bash
# From a checkout of altk-evolve:
uv sync --extra pgvector
evolve-mcp --transport sse --port 8201
```

```toml
[evolve]
enabled = true
url = "http://127.0.0.1:8201/sse"
mode = "direct"
```

`mode = "direct"` skips registry lookup.
</Tab>
</Tabs>

The Memory MCP server needs model credentials (`EVOLVE_MODEL_NAME`, OpenAI/LiteLLM keys). Without them, saving trajectories can fail even if the connection works.

## Try it

```bash
cuga start demo_crm --sample-memory-data
```

Then run a CugaLite task, for example:

```
Identify the common cities between my cuga_workspace/cities.txt and cuga_workspace/company.txt
```

---

## Tuning

| Setting | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `async_save = true` | Save in the background; does not block the answer |
| `save_on_success` / `save_on_failure` | What to persist |
| `mode = "auto"` | Registry first, then direct SSE |
| `mode = "registry"` | Registry only |
| `mode = "direct"` | Use `url` only |
| `lite_mode_only = true` | Memory only on the CugaLite path |

---

## Experimental Memory workspace

The supported full image includes the experimental memory-management workspace. When memory features are available, open **Memory** from chat navigation to inspect guidance, preferences, source conversations, and usage.

| Control | Scope |
| --- | --- |
| Personal memory | Inspect your memory records, open authorized source conversations, edit supported metadata, and forget records. |
| Personal memory preference | Turn retrieval and saving off for your conversations. Reading and personal deletion remain available while service memory is off. |
| Service memory | Administrators control memory for the service; user preferences cannot override a disabled service. |
| Episodic memory | Administrators control episodic processing/retrieval independently of semantic facts. |
| Retention | Administrators manage rules, schedules, pending candidates, and activity when the backend exposes the required capabilities. |

Memory records and preferences are scoped to the service and caller. Administrative access requires the server's Manage authorization; personal access uses Chat authorization. See [Authentication](/docs/configure/authentication).

## Bundled management and retention

Use the **full** image for the bundled Evolve HTTP worker. The slim image excludes Evolve and its PII subsystem. Configure a stable service instance ID and PostgreSQL for durable retention:

```bash
DYNACONF_SERVICE__INSTANCE_ID=cuga-production
DYNACONF_EVOLVE__ENABLED=true
DYNACONF_EVOLVE__MODE=direct
DYNACONF_EVOLVE__URL=http://127.0.0.1:8201/sse
CUGA_EMBEDDED_EVOLVE=true
EVOLVE_BACKEND=postgres
EVOLVE_PG_HOST=your-postgres-host
EVOLVE_PG_PORT=5432
EVOLVE_PG_USER=your-evolve-user
EVOLVE_PG_PASSWORD=<your-evolve-password>
EVOLVE_PG_DBNAME=evolve
EVOLVE_MODEL_NAME=Azure/gpt-4o
OPENAI_API_KEY=<your-evolve-model-key>
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://your-inference-endpoint.example.com
```

Choose an Evolve model/provider configuration compatible with your inference endpoint. **Evolve needs its own model configuration in this version**; configuring an agent's Manage LLM connection does not automatically configure the worker. See the [configuration guide](https://github.com/cuga-project/cuga-agent/blob/main/docs/readme/configuration-guide.md#use-bundled-memory-management-and-retention).

The container supervisor starts the private worker and CUGA together, generates an internal API credential, and scopes Evolve to the service instance. Keep that private API internal. Registry-managed or explicit external Evolve endpoints remain external; an MCP-only integration can retrieve guidelines and save trajectories but does not expose the bundled native retention API.

### Retention capabilities

The UI reflects the backend's reported capabilities. Durable collection and source-deletion handling require PostgreSQL and the bundled native service. The standard policy contains these rules:

| Rule | Default action |
| --- | --- |
| `orphaned-conversations` | Delete after the source conversation has been deleted for 7 days, where supported. |
| `unused-guidelines` | Delete guidelines unused for 180 days; skip when access signals are missing. |
| `stale-guidelines` | Flag guidelines older than 90 days. |
| `old-sessions` | Delete trajectories older than 365 days with derived-record cascading. |

Review rules and pending candidates before running retention. Schedules are stored and executed by Evolve; activity records the outcomes.

<img src="/images/product/memory-retention.jpg" alt="CUGA administrator retention controls with illustrative data" />

Retention controls shown with illustrative sample data from the same product capture.

### Protection hooks

The full image includes configured memory-write and model-egress protection hooks, including structured-identifier filtering and READI named-entity redaction. Check the workspace's compliance/capability status for the active deployment. The slim image does not include these Evolve hooks.
